title: Turkish-Italian Boregi with Zesty Fish
description: A fusion dish of Turkish boregi with Italian flavors and zesty fish filling, perfect for a light dinner.
instructions: Thaw the boregi dough according to package instructions.
In a mixing bowl, combine the flaked fish, crumbled feta cheese, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Unroll the boregi dough and cut it into 12 equal pieces.
Place a tablespoon of the fish mixture onto one half of each dough piece.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Place the boregi on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of marinara sauce, if desired.
